correctness.rationale: Every 32-state de Bruijn Hamiltonian successor is determined by one of 2^16 complementary-output Boolean tables on 16 four-bit suffixes; all tables are checked for one 32-cycle, giving a complete 2048-cycle family without rotation duplicates. Inspected independent Euler-tour DFS enumerator for 4-bit de Bruijn graph and mismatch-count versus sign-product correlation equality. Independently enumerated ALL 2048 cycles, their 65536 cuts and all 31 aperiodic lags using bitwise mismatch/bit_count: reproduced every rooted PSL and cycle optimum histogram entry. Lowest PSL=4 on 40 cuts belonging to 32 cycles, with eight cycles having two optimal cuts; eight cycles have best level=16. Computation is exhaustive of claimed finite universe, not extrapolation to higher orders.
